## Investing for change

TNIFMC is a professional Investment management company managing multiple thematic funds registered under the SEBI AIF Regulations. The government of Tamil Nadu is an anchor investor in all the Funds.

The goal of TNIFMC is to generate attractive risk-adjusted returns through sustainable investing principles.

TNIFMC aims  to play a supportive role in propelling the State’s Gross Domestic Product (GSDP) to $1 trillion by 2030 by channelling Private investments into the startups and enterprises in the state.

## Our Differentiators

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

Our skilled team, led by experienced professionals from diverse industries, offers expertise in deal execution, investment management, and operations.

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

We prioritize investments aligned with our nation’s and state’s goals in achieving broader economic and social objectives.

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

Sustainability is the core of our investment philosophy. We lay emphasis on ESG compliance and focus on contributing to UN Sustainable Development Goals through our portfolio investments.

Tamil Nadu Shelter Fund

TNSF invests in affordable housing projects (both for rental and sale) with an aim to increase the supply of sustainable and affordable dwellings targeting economically weaker section, lower – income group, working women, senior citizens, /and other vulnerable sections.

Tamil Nadu Emerging Sector Seed Fund

Aims to provide growth capital to emerging sector companies.

Tamil Nadu Green Climate Fund

Social Impact Fund that aims to transform Tamil Nadu into a net-zero and climate-resilient state. Its goal is to support projects that reduce greenhouse gas emissions and enhance climate resilience.

## Tamil Nadu Shelter Fund

We aim to invest in affordable housing projects for rental and sale, increasing the supply of homes for lower-income groups, working women, senior citizens, and focused groups.


## Tamil Nadu Emerging Sector Seed Fund

We aim to provide growth capital to emerging sector companies.


## Tamil Nadu Green Climate Fund

We aim to invest in projects that reduce greenhouse gas emissions and enhance climate resilience.

## Investing Responsibly

At TNIFMC, our investments are aligned to make a positive contribution to society and the environment by adhering to prudent corporate governance norms.

##### Environmental Responsibility

We evaluate investments to minimize disruptions, promote a low-carbon future, and comply with environmental regulations.

##### Social Impact

We assess investments for a positive local impact, safe workplaces, diversity, equality, and to avoid harm to vulnerable communities.

##### Strong Governance

We maintain high governance standards, ensuring ethical, transparent operations and compliance with all laws and regulations in both our operations and portfolio companies.
